defmodule CleanerCrm.Clients do
  @moduledoc """
  Clients and their properties: addresses, parking notes, entry
  methods and codes, pets, and cleaning preferences — the authoritative
  access and scope record every job carries.

  Every function is scoped to the caller's active account.
  """

  import Ecto.Query, warn: false

  alias CleanerCrm.Repo
  alias CleanerCrm.Users.Scope
  alias CleanerCrm.Clients.{Client, Property}
  alias CleanerCrm.Audit.Recorder

  ## Clients

  def list_clients(%Scope{active_account_id: account_id}) when not is_nil(account_id) do
    Client
    |> where([c], c.account_id == ^account_id)
    |> order_by([c], asc: c.name)
    |> Repo.all()
  end

  def get_client!(%Scope{active_account_id: account_id}, id) when not is_nil(account_id) do
    Client
    |> where([c], c.account_id == ^account_id)
    |> Repo.get!(id)
  end

  def create_client(%Scope{active_account_id: account_id}, attrs) when not is_nil(account_id) do
    %Client{account_id: account_id}
    |> Client.changeset(attrs)
    |> Repo.insert()
  end

  def change_client(%Scope{}, %Client{} = client, attrs \\ %{}) do
    Client.changeset(client, attrs)
  end

  @doc """
  Lists only active clients, for the account's day-to-day client list.
  """
  def list_active_clients(%Scope{} = scope) do
    scope |> list_clients() |> Enum.filter(& &1.active)

defmodule CleanerCrmSpex.Story832.Criterion7117Spex do
  @moduledoc """
  Story 832 — Manage clients and properties with access details
  Criterion 7117 — Deactivating a client with upcoming scheduled jobs
  hides it from active lists while retaining its history and
  properties.
  """

  use CleanerCrmSpex.Case

  alias CleanerCrmSpex.Fixtures

  spex "owner deactivates a client with upcoming jobs" do
    scenario "the deactivated client is hidden but its data is retained" do
      given_ "the owner is logged in with an active account", context do
        user = Fixtures.user_fixture()
        scope = Fixtures.user_scope_fixture(user)
        account = Fixtures.account_fixture(scope)
        conn = Fixtures.log_in_user(context.conn, user)

        {:ok, Map.merge(context, %{conn: conn, user: user, scope: scope, account: account})}
      end

      given_ "a client with a job scheduled next week", context do
        client_path = create_client(context.conn, "Morgan Reyes")

        property_path =
          create_property(context.conn, client_path, %{service_address: "9 Birch Ln"})

        schedule_job(context.conn, property_path, next_week())

        {:ok, Map.put(context, :client_path, client_path)}
      end

      when_ "the owner deactivates the client", context do
        {:ok, show_live, _html} = live(context.conn, context.client_path)

        show_live
        |> element("[data-test='deactivate-client-button']")
        |> render_click()

        show_live
        |> element("#deactivate-client-dialog [data-role='confirm-confirm']")
        |> render_click()

        {:ok, context}
      end

      then_ "the client is marked inactive and hidden from active lists", context do
        {:ok, _index_live, html} = live(context.conn, ~p"/clients")
        refute html =~ "Morgan Reyes"

        {:ok, context}
      end

      then_ "the client's history and properties are retained", context do
        {:ok, _show_live, html} = live(context.conn, context.client_path)

        assert html =~ "Morgan Reyes"
        assert html =~ "9 Birch Ln"

        {:ok, context}
      end
    end
  end

  defp create_client(conn, name) do
    {:ok, new_live, _html} = live(conn, ~p"/clients/new")

    {:error, {:live_redirect, %{to: path}}} =
      new_live
      |> form("[data-test='client-form']", client: %{name: name})
      |> render_submit()

    path
  end

  defp create_property(conn, client_path, attrs) do
    "/clients/" <> client_id = client_path

    {:ok, new_live, _html} = live(conn, ~p"/clients/#{client_id}/properties/new")

    {:error, {:live_redirect, %{to: path}}} =
      new_live
      |> form("[data-test='property-form']", property: attrs)
      |> render_submit()

    path
  end

  defp schedule_job(conn, property_path, scheduled_date) do
    "/properties/" <> property_id = property_path

    {:ok, schedule_live, _html} = live(conn, ~p"/schedule")

    schedule_live
    |> element("[data-test='new-job-button']")
    |> render_click()

    schedule_live
    |> form("[data-test='job-form']",
      job: %{property_id: property_id, scheduled_date: scheduled_date}
    )
    |> render_submit()

    :ok
  end

  defp next_week do
    Date.utc_today() |> Date.add(7) |> Date.to_iso8601()
  end
end

defmodule CleanerCrmSpex.Story832.Criterion7117Spex do
  @moduledoc """
  Story 832 — Manage clients and properties with access details
  Criterion 7117 — Deactivating a client with upcoming scheduled jobs
  hides it from active lists while retaining its history and
  properties.
  """

  use CleanerCrmSpex.Case

  alias CleanerCrmSpex.Fixtures

  spex "owner deactivates a client with upcoming jobs" do
    scenario "the deactivated client is hidden but its data is retained" do
      given_ "the owner is logged in with an active account", context do
        user = Fixtures.user_fixture()
        scope = Fixtures.user_scope_fixture(user)
        account = Fixtures.account_fixture(scope)
        conn = Fixtures.log_in_user(context.conn, user)

        {:ok, Map.merge(context, %{conn: conn, user: user, scope: scope, account: account})}
      end

      given_ "a client with a job scheduled next week", context do
        client_path = create_client(context.conn, "Morgan Reyes")

        property_path =
          create_property(context.conn, client_path, %{service_address: "9 Birch Ln"})

        schedule_job(context.conn, property_path, next_week())

        {:ok, Map.put(context, :client_path, client_path)}
      end

      when_ "the owner deactivates the client", context do
        {:ok, show_live, _html} = live(context.conn, context.client_path)

        # The trigger button only opens the confirm dialog client-side
        # (JS.add_class — no server round-trip for LiveViewTest to click
        # through); the dialog is always in the DOM, so the spec asserts
        # the trigger exists and drives the dialog's confirm button.
        assert has_element?(show_live, "[data-test='deactivate-client-button']")

        show_live
        |> element("#deactivate-client-dialog [data-role='confirm-confirm']")
        |> render_click()

        {:ok, context}
      end

      then_ "the client is marked inactive and hidden from active lists", context do
        {:ok, _index_live, html} = live(context.conn, ~p"/clients")
        refute html =~ "Morgan Reyes"

        {:ok, context}
      end

      then_ "the client's history and properties are retained", context do
        {:ok, _show_live, html} = live(context.conn, context.client_path)

        assert html =~ "Morgan Reyes"
        assert html =~ "9 Birch Ln"

        {:ok, context}
      end
    end
  end

  defp create_client(conn, name) do
    {:ok, new_live, _html} = live(conn, ~p"/clients/new")

    {:error, {:live_redirect, %{to: path}}} =
      new_live
      |> form("[data-test='client-form']", client: %{name: name})
      |> render_submit()

    path
  end

  defp create_property(conn, client_path, attrs) do
    "/clients/" <> client_id = client_path

    {:ok, new_live, _html} = live(conn, ~p"/clients/#{client_id}/properties/new")

    {:error, {:live_redirect, %{to: path}}} =
      new_live
      |> form("[data-test='property-form']", property: attrs)
      |> render_submit()

    path
  end

  defp schedule_job(conn, property_path, scheduled_date) do
    "/properties/" <> property_id = property_path

    {:ok, schedule_live, _html} = live(conn, ~p"/schedule")

    schedule_live
    |> element("[data-test='new-job-button']")
    |> render_click()

    schedule_live
    |> form("[data-test='job-form']",
      job: %{property_id: property_id, scheduled_date: scheduled_date}
    )
    |> render_submit()

    :ok
  end

  defp next_week do
    Date.utc_today() |> Date.add(7) |> Date.to_iso8601()
  end
end

defmodule CleanerCrm.Clients.Client do
  @moduledoc """
  A paying customer with contact info and preferences.

  Scoped to an account: every client belongs to exactly one account and
  is only ever visible within that account.
  """

  use Ecto.Schema
  import Ecto.Changeset

  @type t :: %__MODULE__{
          id: Ecto.UUID.t() | nil,
          account_id: Ecto.UUID.t() | nil,
          name: String.t() | nil,
          active: boolean(),
          card_on_file: boolean(),
          email: String.t() | nil,
          phone: String.t() | nil,
          preferred_channel: :email | :sms,
          properties: [CleanerCrm.Clients.Property.t()] | Ecto.Association.NotLoaded.t(),
          inserted_at: DateTime.t() | nil,
          updated_at: DateTime.t() | nil
        }

  @primary_key {:id, :binary_id, autogenerate: true}
  schema "clients" do
    field :name, :string
    field :active, :boolean, default: true
    field :card_on_file, :boolean, default: false
    field :email, :string
    field :phone, :string
    field :preferred_channel, Ecto.Enum, values: [:email, :sms], default: :email

    belongs_to :account, CleanerCrm.Accounts.Account, type: :binary_id
    has_many :properties, CleanerCrm.Clients.Property

    timestamps(type: :utc_datetime_usec)
  end

  def changeset(client, attrs) do
    client
    |> cast(attrs, [:name, :active, :card_on_file, :email, :phone, :preferred_channel])
    |> validate_required([:name], message: "is required")
    |> validate_length(:name, min: 1, max: 200)
  end
end

## Findings

**File:** `/Users/johndavenport/Documents/github/cleaner_crm/lib/cleaner_crm/clients.ex`

```elixir
# lines 45-47
def list_active_clients(%Scope{} = scope) do
  scope |> list_clients() |> Enum.filter(& &1.active)
end

# lines 56-58
def deactivate_client(%Scope{} = scope, %Client{} = client) do
  update_client(scope, client, %{"active" => false})
end

# lines 60-62
def reactivate_client(%Scope{} = scope, %Client{} = client) do
  update_client(scope, client, %{"active" => true})
end
```

`list_active_clients/1` **does filter** — it fetches all clients via `list_clients/1` (SQL `WHERE account_id = ...`, no active filter) then filters in-memory with `Enum.filter(& &1.active)`. Functionally correct but not an SQL-level filter (minor inefficiency, not a bug).

`deactivate_client`/`reactivate_client` delegate to `update_client/3` (line 49-54), which calls `Client.changeset/2` then `Repo.update/1`.

**Schema:** `/Users/johndavenport/Documents/github/cleaner_crm/lib/cleaner_crm/clients/client.ex`
- Line 29: `field :active, :boolean, default: true`
- Line 41-46: `changeset/2` casts `[:name, :active, :card_on_file, :email, :phone, :preferred_channel]` — `:active` **is** included in the cast list, so `deactivate_client`/`reactivate_client` correctly persist the flip.

## Test coverage

- No `test/cleaner_crm/clients_test.exs` (or any unit test file) exists — confirmed via `find`.
